original_approved_protocol.scope: Disposable mature-state mechanism forks; not primary active evaluation or capability training
original_approved_protocol.selection_replays: Repeat both fit and future at each ordinary/reset joint, body, and matched-norm parameter point; twelve windows. Hard mask instability makes selection ambiguous.
original_approved_protocol.ordinary: Original observe and both saved AdamW states, original clip and post-step clamps
original_approved_protocol.C_reset: Detach spike ONLY in membrane reset at begin motor and finish body. Pulse/STP/ALIF spike paths keep original ATan SG. Forward state and scores must be identical.
original_approved_protocol.fixed_event: Hold every begin+finish hard mask constant, no spike derivative; absent derivatives count zero. Writer derivative zero is expected, not failure.

matched_norm.scales: r/norm per direction; zero norm produces a zero step
matched_norm.common_head: same ordinary full-step head AND bias displacement in both arms
matched_norm.realized_norm_gate: Each copied FP32 norm must match r within64float32eps*r; require r>10*(64float32eps*max(1,r)). These are numerical-resolution gates, not model or biological parameters.
matched_norm.norm_units: Euclidean mixed parameter coordinates; not biological distance

original_approved_protocol.future_state: Always start at OLD-parameter fit terminal; new-parameter prefix never replaces it
original_approved_protocol.identity_gate: All physical fields including all4 ring slots and same-input hard masks; score/state error <=64float32eps*scale plus observed repeat floor
original_approved_protocol.selection: At fixed scale1: reset joint future improves ordinary joint beyond tau and fit is nonworse; reset body fit improves ordinary body beyond tau and is nonworse than old fit; raw body-only future improves ordinary body beyond tau and is nonworse than old future; reset matched-norm/common-head future improves ordinary beyond tau and matched fit is nonworse. Raw head gradients must match, relative FP32 matched-norm and resolved-radius gates must pass. All identity gates must pass. Any selection-point hard-mask or continuous-state replay instability, head-gradient mismatch or unresolved norm matching is ambiguous, never candidate rejection/support. Otherwise failed predictive gates are locally unsupported. Scale.1 is descriptive, not an alternative selection endpoint.
interpretation: Original SG dot, fixed-event derivative dot, finite branch remainder and hard-mask switches remain distinct.
Future harm alone is not SG error; fixed-event branch derivatives exclude spike crossings and untested clamp branches.
Common/covariance saved-head algebra is retrospective and does not establish motor information sufficiency.
A/B histories are real prefixes before scoring common future targets; no future feature swapping or input-to-output shortcut.
No long-history gradient or capability/convergence claim; any selected candidate needs separate follow-up review.
original_approved_protocol.stopping: Abort on source/data/code change, nonfinite, identity failure, incomplete gradient coverage, count overrun or memory limit; no adaptive expansion.
original_approved_protocol.prior_access: Completed training risk and all6 active B outcomes known; this is a prospective result-informed mechanism diagnosis, not blind prediction.

review_findings: Ordinary instrumentation calls the production begin function. C_reset changes only membrane reset spike gradients in begin and finish; pulse, STP and ALIF event paths retain their original surrogate derivatives.

All 64 begin/finish hard-event calls per 32-event window are covered. The future window always starts from the old-parameter fit terminal state; both candidate forks restore the same complete physical state, parameters, optimizer layouts, moments and counters.

Gradients are recorded before the actual global clip, and actual post-Adam/post-clamp FP32 displacements are used in both gradient-direction ledgers. Matched controls use the same ordinary head+bias displacement.

Selection requires raw body future improvement over ordinary body and nonworsening relative to old future. Small unresolved radii, relative norm mismatch, raw-head mismatch or updated-point hard/continuous replay instability are marked ambiguous.
Same-window common/content algebra is retrospective; a local finite-step result cannot identify the global plateau cause or establish long-history credit or held-out capability.
